'''Ershin Netari''' is a noble from [[Illian]] and one of the [[Council of Nine]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Ershin Netari}}

== Activities ==
He follows [[Semaradrid]] into the final assault on the [[Seanchan]] just outside [[Ebou Dar]].

==Notes==
He is the only member of the Council of Nine that does not have the "den" part in their surname. The significance, if any, is uncertain.
